column11: No nos oyen. Es el apagón de radio.
column12: They can't hear us. It's the radio blackout.

column11: Por fin un poco de intimidad.
Control no nos oye. Es el momento de confesar.
column12: Control can't hear us. Now's the time to confess.

column11: La ventana se ha puesto rosa.
Es precioso y me da miedo.
column12: It's beautiful and it scares me.
Do you trust the heat shield?

column11: Di algo, para saber si funciona el intercomunicador.
column12: Say something so I know the intercom works.
How long until the signal comes back?
I'll count to a hundred. One, two...

column11: Si no lo logramos, los aperitivos están bajo mi asiento.
column12: If we don't make it, the snacks are under my seat.

column11: Si no lo logramos, no los necesitaré.
column12: If we don't make it, I won't need them.
This shakes like a washing machine.
Sing something to calm us down.

column11: La la la, no nos vamos a derretir...
column12: La la la, we're not going to melt...

column11: Si pasa algo, te dejo mi colección de piedras.
column12: If something happens, you get my rock collection.
Do you think Control is worried?
